description: This file defines the 'User' entity class within the OrangeHRM system, using Doctrine ORM annotations for mapping. It models a user with properties such as username, password, status, timestamps, relationships to Employee, UserRole, and user authentication providers, and includes getter and setter methods for these properties.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents a system user with credentials, status, timestamps, roles, and related entities. Uses Doctrine ORM for database mapping and includes methods for accessing and modifying user properties.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the user.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the user.

methods.name: getUserName
methods.description: Returns the username.

methods.name: setUserName
methods.description: Sets the username.

methods.name: getUserPassword
methods.description: Returns the user's password.

methods.name: setUserPassword
methods.description: Sets the user's password.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Checks if the user is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setDeleted
methods.description: Marks the user as deleted or not.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the active/inactive status of the user.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the user's status.

methods.name: getDateEntered
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the user was created.

methods.name: setDateEntered
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp.

methods.name: getDateModified
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the user was last modified.

methods.name: setDateModified
methods.description: Sets the last modified timestamp.

methods.name: getModifiedUserId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the user who last modified this user record.

methods.name: setModifiedUserId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the user who last modified this record.

methods.name: getCreatedBy
methods.description: Returns the ID of the creator of this user record.

methods.name: setCreatedBy
methods.description: Sets the creator's user ID.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the associated Employee entity.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number from the associated Employee entity.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with this user.

methods.name: getUserRole
methods.description: Returns the role assigned to the user.

methods.name: setUserRole
methods.description: Assigns a role to the user.

methods.name: getAuthProviders
methods.description: Returns authentication providers linked to this user.

methods.name: setAuthProviders
methods.description: Sets the authentication providers for this user.
